title: The tithe rolls
Errand for the reeve
summary: {giver} of {settlement} needs the tithe rolls carried to {target}, {distance} to the {direction}.
offer: Every season the rolls go to {target} to be checked against theirs, and every season my courier finds a reason to be ill. Will you carry them? {distance}, {direction}.
complete: Delivered and signed for. You are a reliable sort — I may have more for you.
